## Overview
Add Failure Rate Display

## User Story
As a user, I want to see the failure rate for each job so that I can understand how frequently it fails

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Failure rate is displayed as a percentage
- [ ] Visual indicator shows severity of failure rate
- [ ] Tooltip shows detailed failure statistics

## User Stories

### Create Failure Rate Display Component
- **Story:** As a user, I want to see a visual indicator of the job failure rate so I can quickly assess job health
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Display failure rate as a percentage with 2 decimal places
  - [ ] Show different colors based on severity (green < 5%, yellow 5-20%, red > 20%)
  - [ ] Component updates when failure rate changes
  - [ ] Fits within the job card layout
  - [ ] Accessible color contrast for all indicators

### Implement Failure Statistics Tooltip
- **Story:** As a user, I want to see detailed failure statistics when hovering over the failure rate so I can understand the full context
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Tooltip shows total number of runs
  - [ ] Displays number of failed runs
  - [ ] Shows last updated timestamp
  - [ ] Tooltip appears on hover/focus
  - [ ] Tooltip is keyboard accessible
  - [ ] Tooltip closes when mouse leaves or focus changes

### Create Failure Rate Service
- **Story:** As a developer, I want a service to calculate and format failure statistics so I can consistently process failure rate data
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Service calculates failure rate percentage
  - [ ] Formats statistics for display
  - [ ] Handles edge cases (no runs, division by zero)
  - [ ] Includes utility functions for severity thresholds
  - [ ] Returns formatted timestamp

### Implement Failure Statistics API Integration
- **Story:** As a developer, I want to integrate with the failure statistics API so I can fetch real failure rate data
- **Priority:** P1
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Successfully calls GET /api/jobs/{jobId}/failure-stats
  - [ ] Handles API errors gracefully
  - [ ] Implements retry logic for failed requests
  - [ ] Caches responses appropriately
  - [ ] Updates data periodically


## Non-Functional Requirements
- Performance: API response times < 200ms
- Security: Follow OWASP Top 10 guidelines
- Scalability: Support horizontal scaling
